earlierAttempts.reason: Original application reached unimplemented nested pthread creation in every engine.
Nested creation reached host IO; missing host-call adapter in Deno and shutdown waits timed out in Node/Bun. Fixed diagnostic failure termination before subsequent probes.
Host RPC and the real async completion thread ran; the next missing import was WASI clock_time_get. Deno also exposed an absent parentPort.close method.
All three main subprocesses segfaulted. Koffi used a separate 1 MiB synchronous FFI stack despite the larger OS worker stack. Exact crash harness retained locally; no core dumps or resource events.

16 MiB FFI stack and 12 MiB Wasmtime limit removed the crashes and reached correct output. Harness incorrectly expected 4 GiB without Lean's documented 128 KiB buffer; Deno removeAllListeners was also unimplemented.

Native interpreted oracle produced correct output plus compiler linter warnings; comparison stopped before engine execution. CLI-only warning suppression separates runtime output without editing source.

stackRepair.control: Fixed one-function Wasm recurses until the same engine reports its stack-overflow trap, then returns correctly on a shallow call in the same Store; all three engines pass.
stackRepair.crashHarness: .work/lean-instantiation-r21/harness, with all recorded input hashes verified before preservation

verified: Both interpreted and compiled native oracles match unchanged original input 15 and LEAN_STACK_SIZE_KB=4194304.
Original upstream test and init script are unedited and hashed; only CLI linter diagnostics are suppressed in the parallel interpreter oracle.
Two successful full-main runs per engine produce exact native stdout and exit status.
Nested worker creation waits for the real host response through guest futexes, retaining guest mailbox service.
The actual computation thread exits, joins, and frees its data before main exit; the process then reclaims remaining main/completion workers.
Real clock_gettime provides WASI realtime, monotonic and CPU clock selections. This benchmark is not exhaustive clock API testing.
Seven-thread concurrency, mutex, cross-worker mailbox and cleanup regression still passes per engine.
Bounded stack-overflow traps and recovery pass per engine; no OOM, pressure, swap or resource abort occurred in these attempts.
remaining: Shipping backend selection, package/build integration and self-contained deployment are unimplemented for this helper.
This prototype still loads one frozen application/cache and an older captured runtime identity; the latest packaged candidate is separate.
Most Emscripten imports, dynamic linker globals, full task cancellation and general JS keepalive/event-loop integration remain unfinished.
Host RPC transfers in this diagnostic have an explicit 64 MiB bound; complete large-transfer API parity is not claimed.
Wasmtime control stacks currently have a 12 MiB diagnostic limit below Koffi's 16 MiB maximum; larger general control stacks need a managed helper design, not a reduced Lean test.
Only Linux x64 is validated for this helper; other native platforms and architectural packages remain required.
